fluid_domain.evidence: Pilot envelope of batch 2026-09-24-coolprop-low-temperature (P3 design sections 1.3 and 8.1, decision D9): the nitrogen triple point 63.151 K to 1200 K (1143 K target, 1200 K provisional) and 100 Pa to 10 MPa; every component's own range lies inside. A state past the range of a component it carries is carried, its properties continued and the island's status line noting it (owner rule of 2026-10-16); free water below its melting line freezes as ice Ih, beside CO2-I (no hydrates, WP4). Qualified at G3 (WP9); the declared critical band is research-only. Under the crystal competition (G4, G5; D17 to D19) a gas and a methane-rich liquid carry CO2 below its triple point, qualified to 90 K. Selected only by a test or dev datapack override of networks/default.json.

advisory_evidence: P3_PILOT_PACKAGE: bundled pilot of batch 2026-09-24-coolprop-low-temperature (D9); not a column package; selected by a networks/default.json override only
SPINE_IDEAL_GAS: the reference spines are the only ideal-gas source (no shifted_polynomial_5 fits, D6); methane above 375 K carries its declared CEA/JANAF conflict

EPPR78_KIJ: all six pairs kij(T) from the E-PPR78 rule and icheme:eppr78_2022, Table S4 of the supporting information of Jaubert et al. 2022 (the six pilot pairs equal the earlier Clapeyron.jl transcription)
TR08_ANCHORS: each liquid is translated at its Tr = 0.8 saturated liquid from the Java Helmholtz oracle (volume_translation)
COLUMN_RANGE: temperature_min/max here are the column-style intersection of the property ranges (216.592..1200 K); the fluid network uses fluid_domain

CO2_CRYSTAL_JAEGER_SPAN: the CO2-I crystal is the Jaeger-Span 2012 Gibbs function anchored at the triple point to this family's CO2 liquid, dH_fus 9019 J/mol (D16, D19); read by the engine and the pilot network (G4, G5); the V3 column refuses it
